newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA training jet with two on board missing - paper.
newsitem.headline: SIA training jet with two on board missing - paper.

text.p: A Singapore Airlines (SIA) training jet with two people on board went missing over Thailand on Monday, the Singapore Straits Times said.
The daily newspaper said on Tuesday that the Learjet 31 had left Phuket for Ranong, 170 km north, in the afternoon but had not arrived. Air traffic controllers lost contact with it.
A trainee and an instructor were on board, the paper said.
It quoted an SIA statement as saying the airline was liaising with Thai authorities, who were searching for the aircraft in a forested area south of Ranong.
The missing aircraft was operated by the Singapore Flying College, a susidiary of SIA, the paper said.
SIA officials could not immediately be reached for comment on the report.
